dateline: BTS's Santiago run is complete; the ARIRANG World Tour's next scheduled stop is Buenos Aires (Oct 21, 23, 24).
heroHeadline: Day 4,876: BTS Heads to Buenos Aires After Santiago Run
heroSubtitle: October 19, 2026 is Day 4,876 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The ARIRANG World Tour's Santiago Estadio Nacional nights (Oct 14, 16, 17) were scheduled to be complete; the Buenos Aires Estadio Único de La Plata shows are scheduled for Oct 21, 23 and 24. Independent post-show reports are not yet available.
